items.title: Max Verstappen brings “some samba” to Sao Paulo with Brazil-themed F1 helmet
items.summary: Max Verstappen will race in the colours of Brazil at this weekend’s Sao Paulo Grand Prix after revealing a special helmet for the race.

items.title: Kimi Antonelli to honour Ayrton Senna with special helmet at Brazilian GP
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli will arrive at Interlagos as the 2026 world champion this weekend, and he plans to use the occasion to pay tribute to his racing hero, Ayrton Senna. The Mercedes driver has confirmed he will wear a special helmet at the Brazilian Grand Prix in honour of Senna, marking 35 years since the Brazilian driver won his home race for the first time.

items.title: Kimi Antonelli shares "unforgettable" Ayrton Senna moment after F1 title win
items.summary: 2026 Formula 1 champion Kimi Antonelli went from winning his maiden title to sitting in his hero's car in the space of two days. The Mercedes driver, who clinched the title at the Mexican Grand Prix last weekend, visited Ayrton Senna's family home on Tuesday ahead of the Brazilian Grand Prix.

items.title: Mercedes to race in new suits at Brazil GP in nod to legendary era
items.summary: The Mercedes team will look a little different at this weekend’s Sao Paulo Grand Prix, with world champion Kimi Antonelli and George Russell switching to purple race suits instead of their usual black and turquoise. The design was revealed on Tuesday at the Nubank Parque in Sao Paulo, the stadium of football club Palmeiras, as part of the team’s partnership with Brazilian bank Nubank.

items.title: Lando Norris blasts F1 top speed limiters: “We should easily go quicker than a motorbike”
items.summary: Riding in the slipstream is supposed to be the ultimate offensive weapon for a Formula 1 driver. But according to Lando Norris, the current technical regulations have turned the draft into something a little less useful. Trapped in a train throughout the Mexico City Grand Prix, the McLaren driver vented his frustrations over F1's car.

items.title: Liam Lawson’s remarkable form is giving Red Bull a headache for 2027
items.summary: So far in 2026, Liam Lawson has been a clear standout performer in Formula 1’s midfield. Lawson has scored 83 points so far, nearly twice as many as second-best Pierre Gasly’s 42 – and that’s not even down to his Red Bull stint, during which he barely scored more points per race than with Racing Bulls (4.67 vs 4.31).

items.title: How the F1 world reacted to Charles Leclerc becoming a father
items.summary: Charles Leclerc has received messages of congratulations from across the Formula 1 sphere after he and his wife Alexandra announced the birth of their first child, a daughter named Bianca. The couple shared the news in a joint Instagram post on Wednesday, with a photo of the baby's feet and the caption "Bianca 3.11.26".

items.title: Toto Wolff reveals how Kimi Antonelli came to his office with title pressure “on his chest”
items.summary: Premature celebrations are a dangerous distraction in Formula 1. Long before the lights went out for the Mexico City Grand Prix, the paddock had already mentally crowned Kimi Antonelli the 2026 World Champion. That overwhelming influx of early praise nearly derailed the 20-year-old prodigy. Unable to block out the noise, the Italian driver sought refuge behind closed doors.

items.title: Five things to look out for at F1 Brazil GP
items.summary: The 2026 Formula 1 season is now very much in its final stretch with this weekend’s Brazil Grand Prix marking the fourth-to-last round of the year. There is only one title up for grabs as well after Kimi Antonelli clinched his maiden drivers’ crown in Mexico last weekend, following a dominant campaign for the Mercedes star.

items.title: Charles Leclerc welcomes first child with wife Alexandra as couple shares baby news
items.summary: Ferrari Formula 1 driver Charles Leclerc and his wife, Alexandra Leclerc, have welcomed their first child together. The couple, who tied the knot in a private Monaco ceremony in February 2026, announced the new arrival on social media. They shared a photo of the newborn’s legs and feet in pink knitted leggings and white socks with the caption, “Bianca.

items.title: Max Verstappen needs "a conversation" with Red Bull engine after "random" engine braking issues
items.summary: Ahead of the race weekend at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez – at 2,286 metres above sea level, by far the highest circuit on the Formula 1 calendar – the discussion in the paddock largely revolved around one subject: how much of a challenge Mexico City would pose for the 2026 power units.

items.title: Why Daniel Ricciardo is staying away from the F1 paddock
items.summary: Daniel Ricciardo has delved into the reasons why he has been staying away from the Formula 1 paddock. Ricciardo’s F1 career ended after the 2024 Singapore Grand Prix, when the RB driver was replaced by Liam Lawson after enduring a tough campaign thus far.

items.title: Esteban Ocon's F1 career may be ending, but his story is one of success
items.summary: There's really not much reason to think otherwise: it looks increasingly likely that this could be the end of Esteban Ocon's active Formula 1 career. A career blessed with plenty of highlights, a handful of podiums and a victory scored behind the wheel of a car that wasn't capable of winning on merit.

items.title: “We let him down” – Mercedes takes blame for George Russell’s Mexico GP heartbreak
items.summary: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff has admitted to ‘letting George Russell down’ at Formula 1’s Mexico Grand Prix, with the Briton’s bid for victory derailed within seconds by a technical issue.

items.title: Toto Wolff addresses his future at Mercedes after momentous Kimi Antonelli win
items.summary: Crowning a 20-year-old World Champion is exactly the kind of legacy-defining achievement that forces an executive to evaluate their long-term future. For Toto Wolff, that evaluation is a daily routine. Following Kimi Antonelli's historic title clinch at the Mexico City Grand Prix, the Austrian executive faced inevitable questions about his own longevity at the helm of the Brackley squad.

items.title: Andrea Stella explains how qualifying destroyed McLaren’s Mexico GP: “We paid the price”
items.summary: Having a podium-capable car means much less if you spend 71 laps hopelessly trapped in dirty air. That was the reality for McLaren at the Mexico City Grand Prix. A difficult Saturday qualifying session left the Woking garage entirely on the back foot, completely negating the raw race pace of its machinery.

items.title: Charles Leclerc brushes off Lewis Hamilton clash: “I could be unhappy too”
items.summary: The opening lap of the Mexico City Grand Prix featured an intense, intra-team battle within Ferrari. Battling for the race lead, Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton traded heavy, aggressive blows through the opening sequence of corners.

items.title: Colton Herta to run Cadillac FP1 in Brazil as FIA superlicence quest continues
items.summary: Cadillac test driver Colton Herta will conduct his sixth Friday practice session of the Formula 1 season at this weekend's Brazil Grand Prix to collect his missing FIA superlicence point required to race in the series.

items.title: Mercedes boss praises Antonelli’s masterclass while admitting they failed George Russell
items.summary: The Brackley garage experienced the absolute extremes of motorsport at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodríguez. While the team successfully crowned the youngest world drivers' champion in Formula 1 history on Sunday, the engineering brass was simultaneously forced to publicly apologise to the other side of the garage for a mechanical failure.

items.title: Rafael Camara to debut in F1 Brazil GP as Esteban Ocon out at Haas
items.summary: The Haas F1 team has decided Esteban Ocon will not race again for the squad, with 2027 debutant Rafael Camara getting an early debut this weekend on home soil. Following increasingly strained relations between Ocon and the team, a heated argument in Mexico proved the final straw that made team principal Ayao Komatsu decide to bench the Frenchman.

items.title: The 'difference' between Kimi Antonelli's F1 title and Lewis Hamilton's according to Toto Wolff
items.summary: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff has explained how “different” it felt watching Kimi Antonelli become Formula 1 world champion compared to his record-breaking years with Lewis Hamilton. Antonelli clinched his maiden title in Mexico on Sunday to become F1’s youngest ever world champion at the age of only 20, thanks to a dominant 2026 with four rounds still remaining.

items.title: McLaren to introduce 2027 F1 front wing at Brazil GP
items.summary: McLaren will introduce upgrades to its MCL40 Formula 1 car at this weekend’s Brazil Grand Prix, featuring a front wing concept which is expected to feature on its 2027 challenger.

items.title: Red Bull's rumoured €27million deal takes shape in leaked Max Verstappen shoot
items.summary: A commercial production shoot just accidentally poured gasoline on one of the biggest off-track rumours in the Formula 1 paddock right now. Leaked photographs circulating across social media show Max Verstappen casually resting on the front left wheel of his RB22 while sporting what is expected to be an unreleased team kit.

items.title: Isack Hadjar rues missed opportunity after George Russell clash at Mexico GP
items.summary: Nailing the launch of your life only to get pushed off the track a few corners later is a surefire way to ruin a Sunday. Just ask Isack Hadjar. Starting seventh on the grid at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez, the Red Bull driver executed a flawless getaway.

items.title: Marco Antonelli: "I saw the champion in Kimi after his Australia crash"
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli became Formula 1's youngest-ever world champion at the Mexico City Grand Prix, becoming the first Italian to win the title since Alberto Ascari in 1953.

items.title: Why Honda’s power unit lasted barely five laps in F1 Mexico GP
items.summary: In its Mexico Grand Prix preview, Honda’s Shintaro Orihara had described Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez as “a very challenging track for the power unit”, but he perhaps didn’t expect Aston Martin’s weekend to go so awry.

items.title: How Red Bull's crucial strategy call helped Max Verstappen win the "Maxico Grand Prix"
items.summary: Although Sunday at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez was above all Kimi Antonelli's day, there were naturally two other major storylines in the Formula 1 paddock: the tensions at Ferrari and how Fred Vasseur will manage them, plus Max Verstappen's sixth victory in Mexico.

items.title: Isack Hadjar blames himself for George Russell clash that “ruined” his Mexico GP
items.summary: Isack Hadjar has taken some responsibility for his collision with George Russell at Formula 1’s Mexico GP, in which he miraculously scored two points. Hadjar qualified down in seventh at Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez, two tenths and three spots away from Red Bull team-mate Max Verstappen, but gained two positions courtesy of a decent start.

items.title: Kimi Antonelli labels the "turning point" in F1 title-winning season
items.summary: Kimi Antonelli has labelled the Japanese Grand Prix as the “turning point” in his title-clinching Formula 1 season - saying that win gave him the belief he could become world champion. The Mercedes driver clinched his maiden title in Mexico on Sunday after a dominant 2026 season, yielding nine wins and 16 podiums with still four rounds remaining.

items.title: Lewis Hamilton goes viral after emotional moment with Peter Bonnington in Mexico
items.summary: Formula 1 fans have praised seven-time champion Lewis Hamilton after footage of him congratulating his former Mercedes race engineer Peter 'Bono' Bonnington at the Mexican Grand Prix went viral. Hamilton worked with Bonnington throughout his time at the Brackley outfit, where he secured six of his seven championships.
